final_topology.title: Government Secure Network
final_topology.description: Connect main data center to regional and branch offices with secure internet and remote access.
final_topology.topology_summary: The topology includes a main data center, a regional office, and a branch office connected via a dedicated WAN. It features a secure internet perimeter with email and web filtering, and remote access capabilities.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Asset Management System' (n24) connected to various zones, indicating the presence of an asset management system.

controls.title: Document Data Flows
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Data Flow Documentation System' (n25) connected to various zones, indicating the presence of a system for documenting data flows.

controls.title: Segment Data Processing and Storage Based on Sensitivity
controls.evidence: The topology includes multiple zones (e.g., Main Data Center, DMZ, Non-Production Zone) which suggest segmentation based on sensitivity.

controls.title: Implement and Manage a Firewall on Servers
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Firewall' (n2) in the Main Data Center, indicating the presence of a firewall.

controls.title: Configure Trusted DNS Servers on Enterprise Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'DNS Server' (n15) in the Main Data Center, indicating the presence of a trusted DNS server.

controls.title: Require MFA for Remote Network Access
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'MFA Server' (n16) in the Management Zone, indicating the presence of a multi-factor authentication system.

controls.title: Use DNS Filtering Services
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'DNS Filter' (n17) in the DMZ, indicating the presence of a DNS filtering service.

controls.title: Maintain and Enforce Network-Based URL Filters
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Web Proxy' (n18) in the DMZ, indicating the presence of a web proxy that can enforce URL filters.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain a Secure Network Architecture
controls.evidence: The topology includes multiple zones and security devices (e.g., firewalls, NIDS, web filters) that suggest a secure network architecture.

controls.title: Securely Manage Network Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'IaC Management' (n26) and 'Secure Protocol Manager' (n27) in the Network Management zone, indicating the presence of infrastructure management systems.

controls.title: Centralize Network Authentication, Authorization, and Auditing (AAA)
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Identity Server' (n14) in the Remote Access zone, indicating the presence of a centralized AAA system.

controls.title: Ensure Remote Devices Utilize a VPN and are Connecting to an Enterprise’s AAA Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Remote Access Gateway' (n6) and an 'Identity Server' (n14) in the Remote Access zone, indicating the presence of a VPN and AAA infrastructure.

controls.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Detection Solution
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'NIDS' (n19) in the Main Data Center, indicating the presence of a network intrusion detection system.

controls.title: Perform Traffic Filtering Between Network Segments
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Firewall' (n2) and 'Application Firewall' (n22) in the Main Data Center, indicating the presence of traffic filtering between segments.

controls.title: Manage Access Control for Remote Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'NAC' (n21) in the Management Zone, indicating the presence of a network access control system.

controls.title: Collect Network Traffic Flow Logs
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Network Traffic Log Collector' (n28) in the Management Zone, indicating the presence of a system for collecting network traffic flow logs.

controls.title: Separate Production and Non-Production Systems
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Non-Production Zone' (z8) peered with the Main Data Center, indicating the separation of production and non-production systems.

controls.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Pen Testing Service' (n29) in the Pen Testing zone, indicating the presence of a penetration testing service.

findings_before.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
findings_before.evidence: The topology does not explicitly show an asset inventory system or process. However, it includes various nodes and zones that could be part of an inventory.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of an asset inventory system or process.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing an asset management system and links to all other nodes.

findings_before.title: Document Data Flows
findings_before.evidence: The topology does not provide explicit documentation of data flows.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit documentation of data flows.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing a data flow documentation system and links to relevant nodes and zones.

findings_before.title: Securely Manage Network Infrastructure
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes various network devices but does not explicitly show secure management practices (e.g., IaC, secure protocols).
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of secure management practices.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add nodes and links representing secure management practices (e.g., IaC, secure protocols).

findings_before.title: Collect Network Traffic Flow Logs
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes a SIEM (n20) in the Management Zone, which could collect network traffic flow logs, but this is not explicitly shown.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of network traffic flow log collection.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing a network traffic flow log collector and links to relevant nodes.

findings_before.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
findings_before.evidence: The topology does not provide explicit evidence of periodic external penetration tests.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of periodic external penetration tests.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing a penetration testing service and links to relevant nodes and zones.
